# zip.js

Pinned dependency: `@zip.js/zip.js` version **2.24.0**.

Browser UMD core build: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@zip.js/zip.js@2.24.0/dist/zip-core.min.js`

License source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@zip.js/zip.js@2.24.0/LICENSE`

Project: https://github.com/gildas-lormeau/zip.js

Used by `gallery-download.js` in STORE mode (`level: 0`, `useWebWorkers: false`). No worker, WASM or external CDN runtime request is required. The library supports automatic ZIP64 when needed. The bundled license must accompany redistribution.
